# US-015: Attach Output Examples to a Prompt

## User Story

**As a** ML Researcher (P-003),
**I want to** paste one or more example outputs generated by my prompt,
**So that** community members can evaluate the prompt's effectiveness before trying it themselves.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Given I am on the prompt submission form, when I scroll to the "Example Outputs" section, then I see an "Add example" button that opens an inline editor where I can paste an output and optionally label it (e.g., "GPT-4 output", "Temperature 0.7 result").
- [ ] Given I click "Add example", when I paste text into the example editor, then the text is saved as a collapsible output block on the prompt detail page — each block shows the label, a truncated preview (first 300 chars), and an "Expand" toggle.
- [ ] Given I am adding examples, when I have added 5 examples, then the "Add example" button is disabled with a tooltip indicating the maximum of 5 examples per prompt.
- [ ] Given I am adding an example, when I leave the text field empty and click "Save example", then the example is not saved and I see an inline validation error.
- [ ] Given I am viewing a prompt detail page with examples, when I click the "Copy output" button on an example block, then the full example text is copied to my clipboard and a toast notification confirms the action.

## Notes

Output examples are a key quality signal — prompts with concrete examples receive significantly higher community trust. The 5-example cap prevents the page from becoming unwieldy while allowing sufficient evidence. This feature depends on US-011 and benefits from syntax highlighting (US-022) if the output is code.
